name: ownit-intro-video
description: OwnIt intro video (Remotion): motion graphics cut to a generated soundtrack.

scripts.render: remotion render OwnItIntro out/ownit-intro.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 --concurrency 2 --audio-codec aac --audio-bitrate 256k --timeout 180000
scripts.build: npm run soundtrack && npm run render && npm run render:web
